name: Good Evening Crypto
text: I DOUBLE CHECKED... THIS IS TRUE! 🙌 $XRP
claim: 12 Oct 2026 is exactly 589 days after Trump named XRP in a proposed U.S. crypto strategic reserve.
on_record: Trump's 2 Mar 2025 announcement named XRP for a proposed U.S. crypto reserve. From 2 Mar 2025 to 12 Oct 2026 is 365 days to 2 Mar 2026 plus 224 days, exactly 589 days.

name: Jake Claver
text:
The XRP Ledger keeps leveling up with tools like smart escrows and deeper programmability

Think DeFi primitives running directly on the base layer

Builders will be able to launch full-scale DeFi apps on XRP without a smart-contract layer bolted on top
claim: Builders will be able to launch full-scale DeFi apps on the XRP Ledger base layer without a separate smart-contract layer.
on_record: Smart Escrows (XLS-0100) were still a draft, on a ninth Devnet release in Oct 2026, not mainnet. The design is limited escrow-release logic, not a general base layer for full-scale DeFi apps.

text: XRP All Time High 2026 , EverNorth LIVE & Altcoin Explosion

on_record: An all-time high in 2026 and an altcoin explosion are forecasts, not completed facts. Evernorth's XRPN shares had started Nasdaq trading on 12 Oct 2026, so that fragment matches the record.

on_record: The post names 2026 but no price or day. It is a forecast for the rest of the year, not a high the record has already established.

name: Eri (Carpe Diem)
text: GUMI, also backed by SBI, the largest Class A Shareholder of Evernorth, is an XRP DAT, and trades on a stock market.
claim: Gumi, backed by SBI, Evernorth's largest Class A shareholder, is a listed XRP digital-asset treasury.
on_record: SBI, gumi's top shareholder, is reported to hold 39.9% of Evernorth's voting Class A shares, the largest disclosed stake. Gumi invested $5 million in Evernorth and bought some XRP, but it is a game company, not an XRP treasury.
